messages:
Maya: Quick tactical handoff for Optimize v0.9 announce. Need changelog URL, docs URL (with utm), p95 stat + cost delta, and the SDR routing param by EOD Tue. Can eng/docs confirm?
Sanjay: Changelog PR is merged. I'll post final permalink after docs go live: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/412
Liam: Docs will publish today. ETA Tue 14:00 PT. We'll append ?utm_campaign=optimize_v0.9 to the canonical link.
Olivia: Rollout: canary in us-west @ 09:00 PT, 30m observe, then ramp. Canary is public but limited capacity.
Maya: Can you confirm canary matches GA behavior for screenshots?
Olivia: Yes, same code path.
Samir: I'll snapshot p95 and export baseline vs v0.9 CSV right after canary goes live and attach here.
Priya: Webinar Thu 10:00 PT. Landing page needs product blurb + CTA. Please ensure docs links include utm and webhook sends tag "optimize-launch" so SDR can route to inbound-launch-optimize.
Sanjay: Confirm we'll add "tag": "optimize-launch" and campaign field in webhook payload.
release-bot: Deploy scheduled: optimize/service v0.9 -> canary us-west @ 2025-11-12T09:00:00-08:00; full rollout @ 2025-11-12T09:30:00-08:00. CI: green.
Maya: Final marketing asks: 1) changelog URL, 2) docs URL with utm, 3) two-sentence tweet copy, 4) p95 screenshot + CSV for designer. Post here when ready and we'll schedule Tue/Wed assets. :thumbsup:
Sanjay: Will post final links + one-line summary Tue 14:10 PT in this thread.
Priya: SDR note: set priority P2 for inbound-launch-optimize. I'll validate the first webhook once it's live.
Maya: Thanks everyone.
